prompts.sheet:
A single character model sheet on one sheet of paper, for animation reference.
One character only, shown three times in one frame: full-body front view,
full-body three-quarter view, and a row of three head-and-shoulders expressions
(neutral, determined, surprised). Plain light background, consistent lighting.

The attached image is a style reference. Match its style exactly, meaning its
linework, shading, rendering and palette, but do not copy its subject: nothing
from that picture appears on this sheet except the way it is drawn.

The character:
Kaito Ren, an 18-year-old male rooftop courier. Short messy black hair with a blunt fringe falling over the left eyebrow. Sharp amber eyes, thin angular face, light olive skin. Wears a dark grey high-collared courier jacket over a white shirt, cargo trousers and worn lace-up boots. Distinguishing marks: a long pale scar through the right eyebrow, and a frayed deep-red scarf always wound twice around his neck, one end hanging to his waist.

Match the style of the attached image exactly: its linework, shading, rendering and palette. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no speech bubbles, no sound effects, no signatures, no watermarks and no panel borders anywhere in the image.

verdictNotes: Same person in all three panels: scar through the right eyebrow, amber eyes, short messy black hair, the frayed red scarf.
Every image, the sheet included, is unmistakably in the reference style: watercolour washes, soft palette, visible paper grain, graphite underdrawing; nothing of the manga preset remains.

Caveat: the reference’s subject bled into the panels although the prompt said not to copy it. The harbour, boats and a lighthouse appear in the wide and close-up backgrounds. A style lock in the app would have to pin the place or accept this.
